test_title: PYST 07: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A = B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A > B' means 'A is the father of B'.

How is P related to T if 'P + Q × R > S = T'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 =
 ×
 >
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P + Q × R > S = T

It means: P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Wife of R, R is the Father of S, and S is the Brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac016bcdedc9666025c49ffff766d0c79c48fbe0336d2a8488c6ba18523904d8.png] 

So, T is the **Grandchild** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1 (Mother's mother).
